info.name: SmartParking - SPARK-228 Operational Layout (manual verification)
info.description:
# SPARK-228 Operational Layout - manual end-to-end verification

This collection exercises the read path implemented for SPARK-228:

- `GET {{parkingServiceUrl}}/api/parking-lots/{siteId}/operational-layout` (new dual-mode projection)
- `GET {{parkingServiceUrl}}/api/parking-lots/{siteId}/operator-layout` (legacy aggregate, now SLOT_OVERRIDE-gated)
- `GET {{parkingServiceUrl}}/api/parking-lots/{siteId}/structure` (owner-only regression)
- `POST {{userServiceUrl}}/api/auth/login` and `GET {{userServiceUrl}}/api/auth/me` for role/token setup

## Run order

Run the folders top to bottom. Folder **00 - Setup (run first)** must run first: it stores every role token, the demo `siteId`, and (in later folders) the driver response used by the A7 comparison. The collection expects the companion environment file.

## Default local ports (verified from launchSettings and compose)

- UserService: `http://localhost:5035`
- ParkingService: `http://localhost:5045`
- ReservationService: `http://localhost:5055` (needed by the legacy `operator-layout` route and by Parking write paths)

## Accounts

Use the demo guidance in `SPARK-228-manual-test-guide.md`. The seeded driver is `driver@gmail.com / Password@123`; owner/operator/admin credentials come from `.env` (`SMARTPARK_OWNER_*`, `SMARTPARK_OPERATOR_*`, `SMARTPARK_ADMIN_*`). Do not commit real credentials or exported token values.

## Data-dependent assertions

The demo site may have no `BACKUP` slot. Cases that look for telemetry-visible `BACKUP` log a SKIP note and fall back to shape assertions when none exists. The guide explains how to strengthen these by marking a free demo slot BACKUP through the existing operator endpoint.

request.description: Manual prerequisite, not a gate. Obtain a genuinely expired access token (access lifetime is 24h: AccessTokenService.LifetimeSeconds = 86400), or have a backend developer mint a token with a past `exp` using the Development signing key. When expiredToken is empty the script logs SKIP and asserts nothing; case 2.2 stays Blocked. Do not use a random string (case 2.1 covers malformed tokens) or a logged-out token as an expiry proof.

request.description: Telemetry source: `reservedCount` counts genuine RESERVED from the full row set; BACKUP remains BACKUP in slots[]. Unfiltered telemetry therefore has reservedCount <= slot RESERVED count (equal when no filter changes the set). The <= relation also holds if a filter is added later.
Assigned operator without SLOT_OVERRIDE. LayoutCallerResolver catches FORBIDDEN from slot-scope and falls back to Sanitized visibility; the read still returns 200.

item.name: 06 - Filters
item.description: vehicleType and floor filter slots[] only; metrics are computed before filtering and must not change.

exec: pm.test('all visible slots are CAR', () => pm.expect(body.data.slots.every(s => s.supportedVehicleType === 'CAR')).to.eql(true));

request.description: Filter by CAR. The reader computes metrics over the full projected row set before applying the filter, so metrics must deep-equal the unfiltered driver response captured in 3.1.
Enum.TryParse is case-sensitive; an unknown value returns 400 INVALID_VEHICLE_TYPE before the reader is called.

exec: pm.test('all visible slots match floor', () => pm.expect(body.data.slots.every(s => s.floorCode === floor)).to.eql(true));

request.description: Uses the real floorCode captured from the anonymous response. All returned slots must have that floorCode; metrics must match the unfiltered baseline.
The reader rejects an unknown floor with StructureException INVALID_FLOOR, mapped to 400 by the middleware.

keys.forEach(key => { if (!allowed.has(key) && JSON.stringify(opSlot[key]) !== JSON.stringify(driverSlot[key])) diffs.push(index + '.' + key); });

pm.test('masked zone counts = telemetry zone count + BACKUP in zone', () => {
const backupsInZone = telemetry.data.slots.filter(s => s.zoneCode === sanitizedZone.zoneCode && s.reservationState === 'BACKUP').length;

request.description: Compares the operator Telemetry payload with the driver Sanitized snapshot. Slot count and slotId order must match; only reservationState/sessionType/features/operatorContext may differ. IMPORTANT: metrics are NOT fully identical by design: Sanitized `reservedCount` is the masked count (genuine RESERVED + BACKUP) while Telemetry counts only genuine RESERVED. The test pins that relation instead of literal equality. All other metric scalars and motorcycle capacity must match.
